help.action1Step1: 1. List Produce: Enter your crop, estimated harvest quantity, and village location.
help.action1Step2: 2. Compare Buyers: Review verified company requirements and compare transparent cash rates.
help.action1Step3: 3. Direct Payment: Confirm deal, complete digital weighment, and receive bank payment.

help.action2Desc: Check real-time APMC Mandi benchmark rates vs direct batch contract prices. Avoid commission cuts and middleman deductions.
